name.fr: Sécurité du secteur en marche ! Officier Trudge

notes: When Dueling against Officer Tetsu Trudge Level 40 or higher, these are the only cards that can drop; at lower levels, cards from the standard pool for Legendary Duelists may also drop.
The following rewards were awarded during this event, based on event points accumulated over its course:

rows.text: Access to Officer Tetsu Trudge as a playable character
Access to Officer Tetsu Trudge as a playable character

notes: The player could also obtain rewards by completing Special Orders during the event.

The Card Trader EX appears during this event and remained open until one week after its conclusion. The player can trade their EX Jewels for cards, Booster Items, and Gold. Each card and Booster Item can only be obtained once from the Card Trader EX during this event, but the Gold can be obtained any number of times.
The Card Trader EX was only available during the first run of this event.
